title: Coefficient-independent finite tree extension reconstruction
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative condensed ring and let $t$ be a finite qcqs open-closed tree rooted at a scheme $X$ [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree]. Let $F:\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}\to D$ be an additive exact functor to an abelian category with an ordinary derived category. Let $P$ be an isomorphism-closed class in $D(D)$ and let $M$ be any $\Lambda_X$-module. For each leaf path $p:S\to X$, write $J_p$ for its actual composite of open extension by zero and closed direct image. If $F(J_p(p^*M))[0]$ belongs to $P$ for every leaf path, then $F(M)[0]$ belongs to $P^{*(n+1)}$ for some natural number $n$, where the product is the finite distinguished-triangle extension product [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. There is no coefficient admissibility, flatness or lattice hypothesis.

proof.text: Use the existing coefficient-independent tree_reconstruct helper proved in QcqsLatticeTreeReconstruction. It applies to any module M, any additive exact F to an abelian category D, and any isomorphism-closed derived property P. The leaf premise of the helper is exactly the displayed supported restriction premise, expressed as a dependent pair of a scheme and a leaf path.

theorem qcqs_tree_finite_extensions
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {D : Type v} [Category.{w} D] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree X)
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X) ⥤ D)
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory D)) [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hleaf : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (p : tree.Path S), p.IsLeaf →
      P ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj
        (F.obj ((p.extension Λ).obj ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ p.toRoot).obj M))))) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.extensionProductIter n ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj M))
